rules: Grand Nagus leadership is temporal state.
Government/political authority does not make every business a state organ.
Commercial regulation and enforcement apply only where jurisdiction/current law support them.
Era-sensitive social/legal reforms update policy state rather than species traits.

organizations.instance_model: Each persistent business is its own organization with owners, workers, contracts, assets and liabilities.
rules: Species does not auto-create business ownership.
Contracts and debts are persistent economic state.

ai_guardrails: Do not invent ownership, debt, contract or regulator authority.
Do not infer Alliance citizenship or profession from species.
Do not apply late-era reforms to earlier campaigns.
